text.cn: 早晨太极，晚上广场舞音响开到「整条街都能听见」。有大爷比划：来家里吃饭！翻译软件显示「Come home eat rice」。
text.en: Morning tai chi; evening square dance at street-volume. An uncle gestures: come eat at my home! App says "Come home eat rice".

text.cn: 跟着打太极，被纠正动作十八次。
text.en: Join tai chi; get corrected 18 times.

feedback.cn: 你学会了「松」。大爷竖拇指。
feedback.en: You learn "song" (relax). Uncle gives a thumbs-up.

text.cn: 加入广场舞外圈，步伐像报错的机器人。
text.en: Join the square-dance outer ring like a glitchy robot.

feedback.cn: 音响震耳，笑容真实。你短暂属于这座公园。
feedback.en: Speakers deafening, smiles real. You briefly belong to this park.

text.cn: 接受大爷邀请去家里吃饭（热情好客线）。
text.en: Accept uncle's home dinner invite (hospitality route).

feedback.cn: 满桌菜与反复劝酒。你感叹：中国人真的太热情了。
feedback.en: Table full of dishes and pour-more toasts. You think: Chinese hospitality is real.

text.cn: 微笑摆手逃跑，回酒店点外卖。
text.en: Smile, wave, flee to hotel delivery.

feedback.cn: 安全社交距离保住了，也错过一顿故事。
feedback.en: Safe distance kept; a story dinner missed.
